sql: SELECT h.action, h.old_value, h.new_value, count(*) AS n, max(h.created_at)::text AS ultimo FROM lead_history h JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = h.lead_id WHERE l.status = 'fechado' AND (h.new_value ILIKE '%fech%' OR h.action ILIKE '%status%' OR h.action ILIKE '%fech%') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30
